ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: Titanic Creatures
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
Mass has consequences.
The engine gives every pawn one cell, so even the largest creature walks through a doorway, hides behind a sandbag, and gets penned like a chicken. This mod makes a truly titanic pawn behave like one: a real multi-cell footprint, a destruction wake that flattens curated crushables and holes thin roofs as it passes (while never pathing under an overhead-mountain roof), an auto-attaching size tier driven by bodySize with a curated per-def override, and a largest-tier corpse that becomes a harvestable map landmark over days instead of an instant meat pile.
This is the ENGINE only. No creature in this mod list is wired to it here - that is campaign content, added separately by giving a race ThingDef the RM_TitanicExtension modExtension (or simply a high enough bodySize).
Rides neku.largepawns (Large Pawns) for the multi-cell footprint itself when present, reconciling its size thresholds to this mod's curated tier table rather than running two ladders; degrades cleanly to single-cell footprints (destruction wake, roofs and corpse-site still work) if Large Pawns is absent. Full design: design/Jawa/worldbuilding/research and infrastructure/state/items/TITANIC_CREATURES_MOD_1.md in the source repo.
